entries.proposed_scope: DUN02小型低平顶矿业维修/储料工作棚；12×6×9，单层，不覆盖巨型工坊或完整矿场。

source.source_archive: /Users/a15356015027/Desktop/专业剪辑软件/虚饰作品 v1.3/overrides/mods/[冒险;地形生成]Terralith_1.20.x_v2.5.4.jar
source.selected_plan_level_limit: Lowest stored lower door, otherwise generic minimum nonair + 1; NOT proof of real world entrance

observations.layout: 矩形带凹角的小型矿业支援棚：一侧窄辅助跨有炉、水锅，另一宽跨铺地毯，末侧整排桶；完整覆盖工作棚仅作一个设计提案，不把两跨拆数。
observations.proportion: 保存盒12×6×9且占用y0..5；名字large不表示巨型厂房。地板y0，器具多y1，低梁顶y5，只有一层作业空间。
observations.facade: 去皮云杉柱梁配敞口边界，角柱和中部柱把长边分段；没有完整围墙和普通门，开跨为内外工作界面。
observations.roof: 低平顶用梁格和活板覆盖；凹角跟着主平面收退，不是坡屋顶或矿井顶板已验岩层。活板原始状态需区别整块投影。
observations.materials: stone92、stripped_spruce_log66、spruce_trapdoor57、cyan_carpet20；furnace3、barrel7、damaged_anvil/grindstone/water_cauldron各1。中央灰块含20格地毯，不是厚石台。
observations.circulation: 炉在x0,z1..3，桶在x11,z1..7，水锅(3,1,0)、铁砧(4,1,6)、砂轮(7,1,8)；中央地毯x6..9,z2..6。敞口连接外围与两工作跨，无梯，不宣称地下主矿道已连通。
observations.terrain: 本体含石地坪与覆盖，没有外接拼图接口；来源池将其列为rigid完整单模板。只提案DUN02小型矿业维修/储料工作棚布局，不覆盖巨型工坊、运输线或COD6完整矿场。

entries.independent_design_basis: Two unequal working bays under a notched flat cover, perimeter furnace/water/tool stations and full side storage row; manually compared to historical C004 enclosed shrine/front-court design.
limits: One small covered support workshop only, not a giant factory or complete mining estate.
F02 uncovered frame, F03 excavation and F04 geode receive no additional whole-building proposal.
No native terrain, collision, transport or machine gameplay acceptance; no construction before1000 scope-valid designs.
